items.title: Revisiting somatosensory evoked potentials in motor neuron diseases: neurophysiological insights from a large cohort.
items.summary: To systematically investigate Somatosensory Evoked Potential (SEP) abnormalities in a large cohort of patients with Motor Neuron Disease (MND), and to explore their relationship with Motor Evoked Potentials (MEPs) and clinical phenotypes. We retrospectively analyzed 267 patients with confirmed MND who underwent standardized SEPs and transcranial magnetic stimulation. Patients were divided into pure/predominant Upper Motor Neuron (UMN) and pure/predominant Lower Motor Neuron/Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (LMN/ALS) groups. SEP abnormalities were assessed using internal normative data, including prolonged latencies, reduced amplitudes, and increased N20-P25 amplitudes. MEPs were classified semi-quantitatively as normal or abnormal by independent raters. At least one SEP abnormality was detected in 75 % of patients, with no significant differences between the UMN and LMN/ALS groups. Increased N20-P25 amplitudes were observed in both phenotypes, suggesting widespread sensory cortical hyperexcitability across the MND spectrum. In contrast, abnormal MEPs were significantly more frequent in UMN patients (p < 0.001). No significant association was found between SEP abnormalities and MEP findings. Upper- and lower-limb SEP latencies were strongly correlated (all p < 0.001), whereas increased SEP amplitudes did not correlate with latency abnormalities. SEP abnormalities are highly prevalent in MND and appear largely independent from corticospinal dysfunction. Increased SEP amplitudes likely reflect primary cortical sensory hyperexcitability rather than impaired sensory conduction. These findings support the concept of MND as a multisystem network disorder that involves sensory cortical circuits and highlight the role of SEPs in the diagnostic workup.
items.titleZh: 再探运动神经元病中的体感诱发电位：来自大型队列的神经生理学见解
items.summaryZh: 这项针对267名运动神经元病患者的大型回顾性研究显示，75%的患者存在体感诱发电位（SEP）异常，且在上运动神经元为主和ALS/下运动神经元为主两组中发生率相似。研究发现N20-P25波幅增加在两种表型中均存在，提示感觉皮层过度兴奋是MND的普遍特征，且SEP异常与代表运动通路损伤的MEP异常无显著关联。
items.insight: 该研究为MND不仅是运动系统疾病、而是涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病提供了大型队列的神经电生理证据，提示SEP可能作为评估疾病谱系中皮层过度兴奋的辅助诊断工具，值得ALS研究者关注以拓展对疾病病理生理机制的理解。

items.abstractZh: 本研究旨在系统性地调查一大组运动神经元病（MND）患者中体感诱发电位（SEP）的异常情况，并探讨其与运动诱发电位（MEPs）及临床表型的关系。我们回顾性分析了267名确诊的MND患者，这些患者均接受了标准化的SEP和经颅磁刺激检查。患者被分为纯/主要上运动神经元（UMN）组和纯/主要下运动神经元/肌萎缩侧索硬化（LMN/ALS）组。SEP异常通过内部规范数据进行评估，包括潜伏期延长、波幅降低和N20-P25波幅增加。MEPs由独立评估者半定量分类为正常或异常。至少一种SEP异常在75%的患者中被检测到，UMN组与LMN/ALS组之间无显著差异。两种表型均观察到N20-P25波幅增加，提示MND谱系中存在广泛的躯体感觉皮层过度兴奋。相比之下，异常MEPs在UMN患者中显著更常见（p < 0.001）。SEP异常与MEP发现之间未发现显著关联。上下肢SEP潜伏期强相关（均p < 0.001），而SEP波幅增加与潜伏期异常无相关性。SEP异常在MND中高度普遍，且在很大程度上独立于皮质脊髓功能障碍。SEP波幅增加可能反映原发的皮层感觉过度兴奋，而非感觉传导受损。这些发现支持MND是一种涉及感觉皮层回路的多系统网络疾病的概念，并强调了SEP在诊断评估中的作用。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的大型队列数据，揭示了SEP异常在MND中高度普遍且独立于运动通路损伤，为ALS作为多系统网络疾病的概念提供了新近的临床神经生理学证据。

items.title: Identifying candidate therapeutic targets in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis through a transcriptome-wide machine-learning consensus approach for drug repurposing.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a heterogeneous neurodegenerative disease for which effective disease-modifying therapies remain limited. This study aimed to derive internally recurrent ALS-associated transcriptional signatures and generate directionally interpretable drug-repositioning hypotheses using a consensus machine-learning framework. Two publicly available transcriptomic datasets from motor cortex (E-MTAB-2325) and blood (E-TABM-940) were analyzed using four feature-selection methods within 100 repetitions of 4-fold cross-validation. Probes recurrently selected in models achieving an accuracy of at least 0.90 were prioritized and examined using COGENA pathway enrichment and Connectivity Map drug-signature analysis. Fifteen qualifying models were obtained for the motor-cortex dataset and 55 for the blood dataset. No exact prioritized gene or probe identifier was shared between the two top-100 signatures, but pathway-level integration identified complementary evidence involving glial and immune regulation, proteostasis and vesicle trafficking, MAPK-related stress signaling, cytoskeletal and extracellular remodeling, and RNA-related processes. The motor-cortex dataset additionally emphasized astroglial support, glutamate handling, and inclusion-body regulation, whereas the blood dataset highlighted cytokine regulation and directionally heterogeneous immune, mitochondrial, and metabolic signals. Deferoxamine and disulfiram showed the clearest reversal-compatible profiles in motor cortex, whereas yohimbic acid and atovaquone showed reversal-compatible profiles in blood. Ciprofloxacin, prochlorperazine, and a compound group led by androsterone instead showed concordant connectivity. The results provide transparent, hypothesis-generating gene, pathway, and compound priorities, but they do not establish biomarkers, therapeutic efficacy, or clinical suitability and require validation in independent cohorts and experimental ALS models.
items.titleZh: 通过全转录组机器学习共识方法识别肌萎缩侧索硬化症中的候选治疗靶点以用于药物再利用
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用公开的ALS转录组数据（运动皮层和血液），通过机器学习共识方法识别出与ALS相关的基因和通路，并预测了可能具有逆转疾病特征的候选药物（如去铁胺、双硫仑等）。研究发现不同组织来源的数据在基因层面重叠有限，但在通路层面（如胶质免疫调节、蛋白稳态、MAPK信号等）存在互补证据。该研究属于计算预测，尚需实验验证。
items.insight: 该研究展示了机器学习在ALS药物再利用中的潜力，通过整合多数据集和通路分析，提供了可操作的候选靶点和药物清单，为ALS治疗策略的开发提供了新思路。

aiRead.keyFinding: 识别出运动皮层和血液中ALS相关的转录特征，并预测了去铁胺、双硫仑等药物可能具有逆转疾病相关基因表达的作用。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种异质性神经退行性疾病，目前有效的疾病修饰疗法仍然有限。本研究旨在利用共识机器学习框架，推导内部复现的ALS相关转录特征，并生成方向可解释的药物重定位假说。研究分析了来自运动皮层（E-MTAB-2325）和血液（E-TABM-940）的两个公开转录组数据集，使用四种特征选择方法，在100次4折交叉验证中进行分析。在准确率至少达到0.90的模型中反复选择的探针被优先考虑，并使用COGENA通路富集和Connectivity Map药物特征分析进行检验。运动皮层数据集获得了15个合格模型，血液数据集获得了55个。两个前100特征之间没有共享的精确优先基因或探针标识符，但通路水平整合确定了涉及胶质和免疫调节、蛋白稳态和囊泡运输、MAPK相关应激信号、细胞骨架和细胞外重塑以及RNA相关过程的互补证据。运动皮层数据集额外强调了星形胶质细胞支持、谷氨酸处理和包涵体调节，而血液数据集则突出了细胞因子调节以及方向异质性的免疫、线粒体和代谢信号。去铁胺和双硫仑在运动皮层中显示出最清晰的反转兼容特征，而育亨宾酸和阿托伐醌在血液中显示出反转兼容特征。环丙沙星、丙氯拉嗪和以雄酮为首的化合物组则显示出一致的连接性。结果提供了透明的、假设生成的基因、通路和化合物优先级，但并未确立生物标志物、治疗效果或临床适用性，需要在独立队列和实验性ALS模型中进行验证。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用最新的机器学习共识方法整合多组学数据，为ALS药物再利用提供了新近的、转化导向的候选靶点，具有直接的ALS相关性。

items.title: Repairing the Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis Trial Credibility Gap.
items.summary: There is a long history of early- and mid-phase amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) clinical trial data being used to make claims of clinical benefit that fail to translate into successful phase 3 outcomes. It is suggested that fallacious scientific reasoning is being encouraged by perverse incentives arising from a "clinical trial industrial complex" that greatly influences trial design, data interpretation, and results communication. Recurring fallacies include false premises underlying outcome comparisons, misuse and incorrect interpretation of biomarkers, mismatches between study design and stated objectives, selective reporting of outcomes, over-reliance on post hoc analyses and open-label extension data, and overly optimistic framing of inconclusive data. We argue that these practices, reinforced by misaligned incentives across industry and academia, lead to premature claims of therapeutic promise and tangible harm to patients. To address the resulting ALS clinical trial credibility gap, we call for rigorous adherence to established standards for reporting clinical trial results, clearer distinction between hypothesis generation and hypothesis testing, more measured description of trial results, and more disciplined triage of phase 2 programs. A cultural shift toward scientific skepticism and methodological rigor is essential to accelerate the development of genuinely effective ALS therapies.
items.titleZh: 修复肌萎缩侧索硬化临床试验的可信度缺口
items.summaryZh: 这篇观点文章指出，ALS领域早期和中期临床试验常被用来夸大疗效，但最终在3期试验中失败。作者认为，这种问题源于“临床试验工业复合体”带来的不当激励，导致试验设计、数据解读和结果传播中存在系统性谬误，如错误比较、生物标志物误用、选择性报告和过度乐观解读。文章呼吁严格遵循报告标准、区分假设生成与检验、审慎描述结果，并加强2期项目的筛选，以修复ALS临床试验的可信度。
items.insight: 这篇文章对ALS研究者具有警示意义：它系统性地剖析了ALS临床试验中反复出现的科学推理谬误及其背后的激励结构，提醒研究者在解读早期试验结果和设计2期试验时保持严谨，避免重蹈覆辙，从而推动真正有效的疗法开发。

aiRead.keyFinding: ALS早期和中期试验结果常被过度解读，导致3期失败，根源在于激励错位和科学推理谬误。
aiRead.limitation: 作为观点文章，缺乏实证数据支持，主要基于作者的主观分析和经验总结。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注ALS领域后续是否出现更严格的2期试验设计指南或报告标准更新，以及相关政策变化。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）早期和中期的临床试验数据长期被用来宣称临床获益，但这些宣称往往未能转化为成功的3期试验结果。本文认为，由“临床试验工业复合体”产生的反常激励助长了错误的科学推理，该复合体极大地影响了试验设计、数据解读和结果传播。反复出现的谬误包括：结果比较所依据的错误前提、生物标志物的误用和错误解读、研究设计与既定目标不匹配、选择性报告结果、过度依赖事后分析和开放标签扩展数据，以及对不确定数据的过度乐观表述。我们认为，这些做法在产业界和学术界错位激励的强化下，导致过早宣称治疗前景，并对患者造成切实伤害。为解决由此产生的ALS临床试验可信度缺口，我们呼吁严格遵守既定的临床试验结果报告标准，明确区分假设生成与假设检验，更审慎地描述试验结果，并对2期项目进行更严格的筛选。转向科学怀疑主义和方法论严谨性的文化变革，对于加速开发真正有效的ALS疗法至关重要。
items.frontierRationale: 该文发表于2026年，直接针对ALS临床试验领域长期存在的可信度危机，提出方法论和文化层面的改革建议，具有高度的ALS相关性和转化价值。

items.title: ATXN2 Spectrum Disorders: Genetic Complexity Beyond Dominant Inheritance.
items.summary: The genetic complexity of ATXN2 challenges conventional paradigms in neurodegeneration. While initially linked to autosomal dominant spinocerebellar ataxia type 2, ATXN2 CAG expansions have emerged as a major risk factor for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In a recent article, Saucier et al. describe an Acadian family with a recessive inheritance pattern of ATXN2 -related disease, challenging the long-held assumption of a predominantly autosomal dominant, gain-of-function-driven mechanism. Here, we analyze how ATXN2 's inheritance mode may shift based on repeat interruptions, somatic mosaicism, and gene dosage, suggesting that loss-of-function mechanisms contribute to pathogenesis in certain contexts. We discuss implications for disease classification, genetic counseling, and therapeutic strategies, emphasizing the need for genetic stratification.
items.titleZh: ATXN2 谱系疾病：超越显性遗传的遗传复杂性
items.summaryZh: 本文评论了一项新发现：一个阿卡迪亚家族表现出 ATXN2 相关疾病的隐性遗传模式，打破了 ATXN2 疾病仅由常染色体显性遗传的固有认知。作者提出，ATXN2 的致病机制可能比单纯的功能获得性更复杂，功能缺失机制在特定情境下也可能参与发病。这一发现对 ALS 和 SCA2 的疾病分类、遗传咨询及未来治疗策略（尤其是基因分层）具有重要启示。
items.insight: 该评论文章提示 ATXN2 相关 ALS/SCA2 的遗传模式可能比预期更复杂，隐性遗传或功能缺失机制的存在将直接影响携带者筛查、风险分层和反义寡核苷酸等靶向治疗策略的设计，值得 ALS 研究者关注。

items.abstractZh: ATXN2 的遗传复杂性对神经退行性疾病的传统范式提出了挑战。虽然最初与常染色体显性遗传的脊髓小脑共济失调 2 型相关，但 ATXN2 CAG 重复扩增已成为肌萎缩侧索硬化的重要风险因素。在最近的一篇文章中，Saucier 等人描述了一个具有 ATXN2 相关疾病隐性遗传模式的阿卡迪亚家族，这对长期以来认为其主要由常染色体显性、功能获得性机制驱动的假设提出了挑战。在此，我们分析了 ATXN2 的遗传模式如何可能因重复中断、体细胞嵌合和基因剂量而改变，提示功能缺失机制在某些情况下有助于发病机制。我们讨论了对疾病分类、遗传咨询和治疗策略的影响，强调遗传分层的必要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该评论基于 2026 年最新发表的家族病例，挑战了 ATXN2 疾病长期以来的显性遗传范式，直接关系到 ALS 风险基因的遗传咨询与治疗策略。

items.title: Poor Prognostic Factors After Gastrostomy in Patients With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis: A Two-Center Retrospective Cohort Study.
items.summary: Percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy (PEG) is widely used to manage dysphagia in patients with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS). However, some patients experience rapid clinical deterioration following the procedure. Prognostic factors specific to outcomes following PEG remain insufficiently defined. This two-center retrospective cohort study included 117 patients with ALS who underwent PEG prior to tracheostomy between April 2011 and June 2023. Cox proportional hazards modeling was used to identify independent prognostic factors following PEG. Explanatory variables included age, sex, onset site, percent of normal forced vital capacity (%FVC), disease duration from onset to PEG, and body mass index. Optimal cutoff values for continuous variables were determined using time-dependent receiver operating characteristic analyses. Among six examined clinical variables, four were independently associated with worse outcomes after PEG placement as follows: male sex, spinal onset, lower %FVC at the time of PEG, and shorter duration from onset to PEG. Cutoff values were determined as %FVC < 63% and disease duration < 12 months. Log-rank analyses confirmed significantly shorter post-PEG survival in patients meeting these criteria. Poorer respiratory function and shorter duration from disease onset to PEG were strongly associated with worse prognosis after PEG. Male sex emerged as an independent prognostic factor, suggesting potential biological differences in disease progression after gastrostomy. These findings underscore the importance of comprehensive clinical evaluation when considering PEG in patients with ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化患者胃造口术后不良预后因素：一项双中心回顾性队列研究
items.summaryZh: 这项双中心回顾性研究分析了117例ALS患者，发现PEG术后预后不良的独立预测因素包括：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时用力肺活量低于63%、以及从起病到PEG时间短于12个月。符合这些标准的患者术后生存期显著缩短。研究提示，在决定是否进行PEG时，应综合评估呼吸功能和疾病病程，而非仅考虑吞咽困难。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS患者胃造口术的时机选择提供了量化依据，尤其是%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月的截断值，可直接用于临床决策，帮助识别术后快速恶化的高风险人群，值得ALS多学科团队关注。

items.abstractZh: 经皮内镜下胃造口术（PEG）广泛用于管理肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）患者的吞咽困难。然而，部分患者在术后出现快速临床恶化。针对PEG术后结局的特异性预后因素仍不明确。这项双中心回顾性队列研究纳入了2011年4月至2023年6月期间在气管切开前接受PEG的117例ALS患者。采用Cox比例风险模型识别PEG术后的独立预后因素。解释变量包括年龄、性别、起病部位、用力肺活量占预计值百分比（%FVC）、从起病到PEG的病程以及体重指数。连续变量的最佳截断值通过时间依赖性受试者工作特征分析确定。在六项临床变量中，四项与PEG置入后较差结局独立相关：男性、脊髓起病、PEG时较低的%FVC以及从起病到PEG的较短病程。截断值确定为%FVC < 63%和病程 < 12个月。Log-rank分析证实，符合这些标准的患者PEG术后生存期显著缩短。较差的呼吸功能和从疾病起病到PEG的较短病程与PEG术后较差预后密切相关。男性作为独立预后因素出现，提示胃造口术后疾病进展可能存在生物学差异。这些发现强调了在考虑对ALS患者进行PEG时进行全面临床评估的重要性。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2011-2023年双中心数据，提供了PEG术后不良预后的新截断值，具有直接的临床转化价值，可优化ALS患者营养支持策略。

items.title: Circular RNAs in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a fatal neurodegenerative disorder characterized by the progressive loss of motor neurons, with most cases lacking a clear genetic basis. Emerging evidence highlights the involvement of non-coding RNAs, particularly circular RNAs (circRNAs), in disease onset and progression. Here, we investigated circRNAs implicated in ALS and related motor neuron diseases (MNDs). Here, we provide a general overview of circular RNA metabolism and cellular functions. We then present our systematic literature review that identified ALS-associated circRNAs, followed by in silico analyses of 15 circular RNA candidates that were selected based on the most compelling data regarding ALS. Our results revealed that several circular RNAs regulate ALS-related genes, such as unfolded protein response, oxidative stress, cell cycle regulation, and apoptosis. Protein-RNA interaction analysis further showed that ALS-related circRNAs can sponge 20 RNA-binding proteins. Additionally, molecular docking analysis demonstrated that ALS-associated FUS variants significantly alter its binding affinity to circular RNAs. RNA-seq data from ALS patients confirmed significant alterations in the expression of host genes of ALS-related circRNAs and hub proteins in ALS-affected CNS tissues. Collectively, our findings identify circRNAs as potential key contributors to ALS pathogenesis.
items.evidenceLevel: 观察性临床研究（基于文献回顾、计算分析与患者组织数据）
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化中的环状RNA
items.summaryZh: 这项研究通过系统性文献回顾和计算机模拟分析，筛选出15个与ALS相关的环状RNA（circRNA）候选分子。研究发现这些circRNA可能通过调控未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期和凋亡等ALS相关通路参与疾病机制，并能海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。特别值得注意的是，ALS相关的FUS基因突变会改变其与circRNA的结合能力，提示circRNA可能参与FUS相关的病理过程。患者组织RNA-seq数据也证实了相关基因表达的改变。
items.insight: 该研究为circRNA在ALS发病机制中的作用提供了系统性证据，特别是揭示了circRNA与FUS蛋白突变之间的相互作用，为散发性ALS（占大多数、缺乏明确遗传基础）提供了新的分子机制视角，并可能为未来开发基于circRNA的生物标志物或治疗靶点奠定基础。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）是一种致命的神经退行性疾病，其特征是运动神经元的进行性丧失，大多数病例缺乏明确的遗传基础。新出现的证据强调了非编码RNA，特别是环状RNA（circRNAs），在疾病发生和进展中的作用。在此，我们研究了与ALS及相关运动神经元疾病（MNDs）有关的circRNAs。我们首先概述了环状RNA的代谢和细胞功能，随后进行了系统性文献回顾以识别与ALS相关的circRNAs，并基于最有力的数据对15个circRNA候选分子进行了计算机模拟分析。结果显示，多个环状RNA调控ALS相关基因，涉及未折叠蛋白反应、氧化应激、细胞周期调控和凋亡等通路。蛋白质-RNA相互作用分析进一步表明，ALS相关circRNAs可海绵吸附20个RNA结合蛋白。此外，分子对接分析显示，ALS相关的FUS变异显著改变其与circRNAs的结合亲和力。来自ALS患者的RNA-seq数据证实，在ALS受累的中枢神经系统中，ALS相关circRNAs的宿主基因及核心蛋白的表达存在显著改变。总之，我们的研究结果将circRNAs确定为ALS发病机制的潜在关键贡献者。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，结合系统文献回顾与多组学计算分析，系统揭示了circRNA在ALS（尤其是散发性病例）中的调控网络及其与FUS突变的相互作用，具有明确的ALS转化研究价值。

items.title: Nuclear SOD1 links ATM-CHK2 signaling to ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A cellular models of ALS.
items.summary: The activity of S-nitrosoglutathione reductase (ADH5/GSNOR) has been proposed being essential to limit oxidative stress and preserve mitochondrial quality control. Here we identify a redox-dependent ATM-CHK2-SOD1 signaling axis that drives ADH5/GSNOR transcription in SH-SY5Y cells expressing the ALS-associated SOD1 G93A mutant. ATM-CHK2 activation promotes the interaction of SOD1 with CHK2, leading to SOD1 nuclear translocation and binding to the ADH5 promoter. Pharmacological inhibition of ATM or CHK2 abolishes these effects. ADH5/GSNOR overexpression protects cells from SOD1 G93A -induced toxicity suggesting that the modulation of GSNOR activity may represent a potential strategy to restore redox homeostasis in ALS.
items.titleZh: 核SOD1将ATM-CHK2信号与ALS SHSY-5Y SOD1 G93A细胞模型中的ADH5/GSNOR转录联系起来
items.summaryZh: 这项细胞研究发现了一条新的信号通路：在表达SOD1 G93A突变体的细胞中，ATM-CHK2信号激活后促使SOD1进入细胞核，进而启动ADH5/GSNOR基因的转录。ADH5/GSNOR是一种抗氧化酶，其过表达能减轻SOD1突变带来的细胞毒性。研究提示，通过药物干预这条通路或增强GSNOR活性，可能有助于对抗ALS中的氧化应激损伤。
items.insight: 该研究首次将DNA损伤应答激酶ATM-CHK2与SOD1的核功能及抗氧化基因转录直接联系起来，为理解SOD1突变如何驱动ALS氧化还原失衡提供了新的分子机制，并提示GSNOR可作为潜在治疗靶点。

aiRead.limitation: 仅基于单一细胞系（SH-SY5Y）的体外实验，缺乏动物模型或患者样本验证；未明确ATM-CHK2-SOD1轴在体内ALS病理中的实际贡献。
aiRead.watchNext: 关注后续是否在SOD1转基因小鼠或患者iPSC来源的运动神经元中验证该信号轴，以及ATM/CHK2抑制剂或GSNOR增强剂在体内模型中的疗效评估。

items.abstractZh: S-亚硝基谷胱甘肽还原酶（ADH5/GSNOR）的活性被认为对于限制氧化应激和维持线粒体质量控制至关重要。本研究在表达ALS相关SOD1 G93A突变体的SH-SY5Y细胞中，鉴定出一条氧化还原依赖的ATM-CHK2-SOD1信号轴，该信号轴驱动ADH5/GSNOR转录。ATM-CHK2激活促进SOD1与CHK2的相互作用，导致SOD1核转位并结合至ADH5启动子。药理学抑制ATM或CHK2可消除这些效应。ADH5/GSNOR过表达可保护细胞免受SOD1 G93A诱导的毒性，提示调节GSNOR活性可能代表一种恢复ALS中氧化还原稳态的潜在策略。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，揭示了SOD1突变通过ATM-CHK2信号轴调控抗氧化基因转录的新机制，具有直接的ALS病理相关性，并为靶向GSNOR的转化策略提供了细胞水平依据。

items.title: The Great Transatlantic Divide: The Case of Experimental Neuropharmacology.
items.summary: Despite substantial agreement between the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) and the European Medicines Agency (EMA) on new drug approval in the past decades, a few new drugs for the treatment of some of the most prevalent and severe neurological disorders, such as Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, as well as much rarer neurogenetic disorders, were handled differently by the two regulatory agencies. The possible reasons for the differing behaviors of the FDA and EMA are several and wide-ranging, and they will be examined in this opinion-based analysis. How patients' perceptions of the complex approaches to drug approval and commercialization may create disappointment and confusion will also be reappraised.
items.titleZh: 大西洋两岸的分歧：实验性神经药理学案例
items.summaryZh: 本文是一篇观点性分析，探讨FDA与EMA在审批某些神经系统疾病（包括ALS）新药时的分歧。文章指出，尽管两大机构总体审批一致，但在少数药物上存在不同决策，可能原因包括监管标准、证据要求或风险偏好差异。作者还讨论了患者对审批过程的认知可能带来的失望和困惑。
items.insight: 对于ALS研究者而言，理解FDA与EMA的监管分歧有助于把握药物开发策略，尤其是在基因疗法和反义寡核苷酸（ASO）等新兴治疗手段的审批路径上，可能影响临床试验设计和全球注册计划。

aiRead.watchNext: 关注具体药物案例的监管决策细节，以及未来监管协调趋势。

items.abstractZh: 尽管过去几十年美国食品药品监督管理局（FDA）和欧洲药品管理局（EMA）在新药审批上存在实质性共识，但对于一些最常见和严重的神经系统疾病（如阿尔茨海默病、帕金森病和肌萎缩侧索硬化症）以及更为罕见的神经遗传性疾病，两家监管机构对少数新药的处理方式有所不同。FDA和EMA行为差异的可能原因多种多样且范围广泛，本文将基于观点进行分析。患者对药物审批和商业化的复杂方法的认知可能造成失望和困惑，这一点也将被重新评估。
items.frontierRationale: 该分析聚焦于2026年最新监管动态，直接涉及ALS等神经退行性疾病的药物审批差异，对转化研究具有指导价值。

items.title: Phrenic nerve amplitude as an effort-independent prognostic biomarker of respiratory failure in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: In amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS), the effort-dependent respiratory metrics used to determine the timing of non-invasive ventilation (NIV) lose reliability as bulbar and/or cognitive impairment progresses. We tested whether the effort-independent phrenic nerve compound muscle action potential (CMAP) amplitude predicts the timing of NIV independently of forced vital capacity (FVC) and the revised ALS Functional Rating Scale (ALSFRS-R). Pre-registered analysis of a single-centre ALS cohort (n = 1,486) contributing 2968 serial phrenic nerve conduction studies. Amplitude was expressed as percentage of an age- and sex-predicted value (per 10% decrease), and time to NIV initiation was the primary outcome (death competing). We used cause-specific Cox models, time-dependent and bootstrap-validated discrimination, and a Bayesian joint longitudinal-survival model. Lower amplitude predicted earlier NIV (adjusted hazard ratio [HR] 1.22 per 10% decrease, 95% CI 1.16-1.27; likelihood-ratio χ 2 = 77.6, p ≈ 10⁻1⁸). The association was concentrated in the first year (HR 1.31, 1.24-1.38) and attenuated thereafter. The optimism-corrected discrimination increment over the clinical model was +0.055 (0.034-0.073); below-normal amplitude approximately doubled 12-month NIV risk (62% vs 29%). In the joint model the current amplitude (HR 1.57, 1.46-1.69) and its rate of decline (HR 1.30, 1.20-1.44) were independently prognostic. Phrenic nerve conduction studies, an effort-independent neurophysiological marker carried robust, near-term, incremental prognostic information for NIV beyond FVC and ALSFRS-R, establishing diaphragmatic motor amplitude as a candidate biomarker for objective respiratory prognostication in ALS. External validation and recalibration are required before clinical use.
items.titleZh: 膈神经波幅作为肌萎缩侧索硬化呼吸衰竭的非用力依赖性预后生物标志物
items.summaryZh: 这项大型单中心观察性研究（n=1,486）发现，膈神经CMAP波幅——一种不需要患者用力配合的神经电生理指标——能独立于FVC和ALSFRS-R预测ALS患者何时需要启动无创通气（NIV）。波幅每降低10%，NIV风险增加约22%，且这种预测力在发病后第一年内最强。波幅低于正常值的患者，12个月内需要NIV的风险约为正常者的两倍（62% vs 29%）。该指标有望成为客观评估ALS呼吸功能、辅助临床决策的候选生物标志物，但尚需外部验证。
items.insight: 这项研究为ALS呼吸功能评估提供了一个关键的新视角：传统依赖患者用力配合的肺功能指标（如FVC）在延髓受累或认知障碍患者中可靠性下降，而膈神经CMAP波幅作为客观、非用力依赖的电生理指标，能更准确地预测近期NIV需求，可能填补临床评估中的关键空白，值得关注其后续外部验证结果。

aiRead.keyFinding: 膈神经CMAP波幅（当前值及其下降速率）在FVC和ALSFRS-R之外，独立且显著地预测ALS患者NIV启动时间，尤其在发病后第一年内预测价值最高。
aiRead.limitation: 单中心研究，需要外部验证和校准；波幅预测力随时间衰减，长期预测价值有限；研究未报告膈神经CMAP测量在延髓起病或认知障碍严重亚组中的具体表现。

items.abstractZh: 在肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）中，用于确定无创通气（NIV）时机的用力依赖性呼吸指标会随着延髓和/或认知功能障碍的进展而失去可靠性。我们测试了非用力依赖的膈神经复合肌肉动作电位（CMAP）波幅是否能在独立于用力肺活量（FVC）和修订版ALS功能评定量表（ALSFRS-R）的情况下预测NIV的时机。对单中心ALS队列（n=1,486）进行了预注册分析，共纳入2,968次系列膈神经传导研究。波幅以年龄和性别预测值的百分比表示（每下降10%），主要结局为NIV启动时间（死亡为竞争事件）。我们使用了原因特异性Cox模型、时间依赖性和自举验证的判别分析，以及贝叶斯联合纵向-生存模型。较低的波幅预测了更早的NIV（校正风险比[HR] 1.22，每下降10%，95% CI 1.16-1.27；似然比χ²=77.6，p≈10⁻¹⁸）。该关联集中在第一年（HR 1.31，1.24-1.38），之后减弱。经乐观校正后，相对于临床模型的判别增量（C-index）为+0.055（0.034-0.073）；低于正常波幅使12个月NIV风险大约翻倍（62% vs 29%）。在联合模型中，当前波幅（HR 1.57，1.46-1.69）及其下降速率（HR 1.30，1.20-1.44）均具有独立的预后价值。膈神经传导研究作为一种非用力依赖的神经生理学标志物，在FVC和ALSFRS-R之外，为NIV提供了稳健、近期、增量的预后信息，确立了膈肌运动波幅作为ALS客观呼吸预后候选生物标志物的地位。在临床使用前需进行外部验证和重新校准。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年发表的近1,500例大型队列数据，首次系统验证了膈神经CMAP波幅作为非用力依赖性生物标志物在ALS呼吸衰竭预测中的增量价值，具有直接的临床转化潜力。

items.title: Early weight loss predicts poorer prognosis and highlights limitations of predictive energy equations in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
items.summary: Weight loss and malnutrition are associated with poorer outcomes in people living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (plwALS). This study investigated the prognostic relevance of early weight loss in plwALS and assessed whether existing energy equations provide useful guidance for nutritional management. In this prospective case-control and within-case comparison study (March 2016October 2024), 170 plwALS and 173 non-neurodegenerative disease controls completed baseline anthropometric and metabolic assessment. Participants with ALS were classified according to weight change during the first six months following study inclusion as Weight Gain, Stable Weight, or Weight Loss. Weight-change groups were compared for subsequent changes in anthropometry, functional capacity, and survival. In a nested cohort of 82 plwALS with reported energy intake and repeat assessments, we assessed whether the relationship between reported intake and equation-derived energy requirements was concordant with subsequent weight change. Early weight loss was associated with continued loss of body weight, fat mass, and fat-free mass, faster functional decline, and increased risk of earlier death relative to Weight Gain (HR=4.78 [95% CI 2.68-8.53], p<0.001). Concordance between equation-derived energy requirements, reported energy intake and observed weight trajectory was low (17.3-32.1%). The IBW30(30) equation showed the greatest concordance among participants with Weight Loss, but no equation performed consistently across weight-change groups. Early weight loss identifies plwALS at increased risk of subsequent weight and body-composition loss, functional decline and earlier death. Existing energy equations proposed for use in ALS show limited concordance with observed weight trajectories, particularly when applied at a single time point. These findings support serial monitoring of nutritional risk and individualized, phenotype-informed dietetic care in ALS.
items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症中早期体重下降预示较差预后，并凸显预测性能量方程的局限性
items.summaryZh: 这项前瞻性研究跟踪了170名ALS患者，发现确诊后6个月内体重下降的患者，后续体重和肌肉量持续减少、功能衰退更快，死亡风险是体重稳定或增加者的4.78倍。研究还发现，常用的能量计算公式（如IBW30(30)）与实际体重变化的一致性很低（17%-32%），单次评估难以准确指导营养干预。因此，ALS患者应定期监测体重和身体成分，并根据个体情况制定营养方案。
items.insight: 该研究为ALS营养管理提供了关键证据：早期体重下降不仅是预后不良的强预测因子，还揭示了现有能量方程在临床实践中的不足，提示需要更动态、个体化的营养评估策略，可能影响未来ALS临床试验的设计和患者护理标准。

items.abstractZh: 体重下降和营养不良与肌萎缩侧索硬化症（plwALS）患者较差的预后相关。本研究探讨了早期体重下降在plwALS中的预后意义，并评估现有能量方程是否为营养管理提供有用指导。在这项前瞻性病例对照和病例内比较研究（2016年3月至2024年10月）中，170名plwALS患者和173名非神经退行性疾病对照者完成了基线性人体测量和代谢评估。根据纳入研究后前六个月的体重变化，将ALS患者分为体重增加、体重稳定或体重下降组。比较各体重变化组在后续人体测量、功能能力和生存方面的变化。在一个由82名报告能量摄入并接受重复评估的plwALS患者组成的嵌套队列中，我们评估了报告摄入量与方程推导的能量需求之间的关系是否与随后的体重变化一致。早期体重下降与持续的体重、脂肪量和去脂体重下降、更快的功能衰退以及相对于体重增加组更高的早期死亡风险相关（HR=4.78 [95% CI 2.68-8.53]，p<0.001）。方程推导的能量需求、报告的能量摄入和观察到的体重轨迹之间的一致性较低（17.3-32.1%）。IBW30(30)方程在体重下降组中显示出最高的一致性，但没有一个方程在所有体重变化组中表现一致。早期体重下降可识别出后续体重和身体成分下降、功能衰退和早期死亡风险增加的plwALS患者。现有用于ALS的能量方程与观察到的体重轨迹一致性有限，尤其是在单时间点应用时。这些发现支持在ALS中进行系列营养风险监测和个体化、表型指导的饮食护理。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新数据，直接关联ALS临床管理中的营养干预，具有高转化价值，为个体化营养治疗提供了新依据。

items.title: Efficacy and safety of memantine in adults with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
items.summary: Amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurodegenerative disease with limited disease-modifying treatment options. Memantine, an N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor antagonist, has been investigated in ALS, but its safety remains unclear. This study systematically assessed the safety of memantine in adults with ALS. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted following PRISMA 2020 guidelines, searching PubMed, Cochrane Library, Scopus, and Web of Science for randomized controlled trials of memantine in adults with ALS. Outcomes included ALSFRS-R and FVC decline, adverse neurological events, total and serious adverse events, treatment discontinuation, and all-cause mortality. Risk of bias was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool. Because of heterogeneous reporting and missing variance estimates, ALSFRS-R and FVC outcomes were synthesized narratively; only safety outcomes were pooled quantitatively. Three randomized controlled trials (706 participants) met the inclusion criteria. Functional and respiratory outcomes could not be pooled because of heterogeneous reporting, and no consistent benefit was observed. Memantine showed lower headache incidence than placebo (RR 0.43; 95% CI 0.19-0.96), with no significant differences in constipation, falls, dizziness, treatment discontinuation, or all-cause mortality. Memantine showed a borderline increase in serious adverse events (RR 1.52; 95% CI 1.00-2.31) and a higher risk of total adverse events (RR 1.19; 95% CI 1.09-1.30). Memantine was associated with a small but significant increase in total adverse events and a trend toward more serious adverse events, without improving functional decline, respiratory function, or survival in ALS. Current evidence does not support its use as a disease-modifying or adjunctive therapy. Trial registration: PROSPERO CRD420261277874.

items.titleZh: 美金刚治疗成人肌萎缩侧索硬化症的疗效与安全性：系统评价与荟萃分析
items.summaryZh: 这项荟萃分析汇总了3项随机对照试验共706名ALS患者的数据，评估美金刚的安全性和疗效。结果显示，美金刚未能改善ALS患者的功能衰退、呼吸功能或生存期，但总不良事件风险显著增加，严重不良事件也呈增多趋势。唯一观察到的好处是头痛发生率低于安慰剂。作者认为现有证据不支持美金刚作为ALS的疾病修饰或辅助治疗。
items.insight: 这项研究对ALS研究者具有重要警示价值：它系统性地否定了美金刚在ALS中的治疗价值，并提示该药物可能增加不良事件负担。在NMDA受体拮抗剂仍被探索用于神经保护的背景下，此结果有助于避免在ALS人群中开展低价值临床试验，并为评估同类药物提供了安全性参照。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS）是一种进行性神经退行性疾病，目前可改善病程的治疗选择有限。美金刚是一种N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸受体拮抗剂，已在ALS中开展研究，但其安全性仍不明确。本研究系统评估了美金刚在成人ALS患者中的安全性。按照PRISMA 2020指南进行系统评价和荟萃分析，检索PubMed、Cochrane Library、Scopus和Web of Science中关于美金刚治疗成人ALS的随机对照试验。结局指标包括ALSFRS-R和FVC下降、不良神经事件、总不良事件和严重不良事件、治疗中断及全因死亡率。使用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估偏倚风险。由于报告异质性和方差估计缺失，ALSFRS-R和FVC结局采用叙述性综合；仅安全性结局进行定量合并。3项随机对照试验（706名参与者）符合纳入标准。由于报告异质性，功能性和呼吸性结局无法合并，且未观察到一致的获益。与安慰剂相比，美金刚组头痛发生率较低（RR 0.43；95% CI 0.19-0.96），在便秘、跌倒、头晕、治疗中断或全因死亡率方面无显著差异。美金刚组严重不良事件呈临界性增加（RR 1.52；95% CI 1.00-2.31），总不良事件风险较高（RR 1.19；95% CI 1.09-1.30）。美金刚与总不良事件小幅但显著增加及严重不良事件增多趋势相关，但未改善ALS患者的功能衰退、呼吸功能或生存期。当前证据不支持其作为疾病修饰或辅助治疗的应用。试验注册：PROSPERO CRD420261277874。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究为2026年发表的基于最新随机对照试验的系统评价，直接回应了ALS疾病修饰治疗选择有限的临床痛点，具有明确的转化决策价值。

items.title: BetaII-spectrin gaps and patches emerge from the patterned assembly of the actin/spectrin membrane skeleton in human motor neuron axons.
items.summary: The actin/spectrin membrane-associated periodic skeleton (MPS) is a cytoskeletal structure that supports axonal integrity and function. Lower spinal motor neurons (MNs) are characterized by exceptionally long axons and are particularly susceptible to degeneration in a wide range of hereditary neuromuscular disorders, including amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Using confocal and super-resolution imaging, we characterized the spatial distribution of βII-spectrin and the assembly pattern of the MPS in human MN axons derived from induced pluripotent stem cells. We discovered a striking gap-and-patch pattern in the medial axon, where sharply demarcated βII-spectrin gaps alternate with patches containing a well-organized MPS. The pattern is acutely induced by the kinase inhibitor staurosporine and pharmacological inhibition of actin polymerization prevents patch formation, indicating a requirement for actin nucleation in MPS assembly. Our data supports a model in which spectrin incorporation into nascent MPS patches depletes neighboring regions, producing long-range gaps-and-patches patterns.
items.titleZh: βII-血影蛋白间隙与斑块源于人运动神经元轴突中肌动蛋白/血影蛋白膜骨架的模式化组装
items.summaryZh: 这项研究利用人诱导多能干细胞来源的运动神经元，结合超分辨成像，发现轴突中βII-血影蛋白呈现规律的“间隙-斑块”分布模式。这种模式由肌动蛋白聚合驱动的血影蛋白局部组装所形成，并受激酶抑制剂星形孢菌素调控。研究为理解运动神经元轴突细胞骨架的组装规则及其在ALS等疾病中的脆弱性提供了新视角。
items.insight: 该研究首次在人类运动神经元轴突中揭示了膜骨架蛋白βII-血影蛋白的间隙-斑块组装模式，并阐明了其形成依赖于肌动蛋白成核。由于轴突细胞骨架的完整性对运动神经元存活至关重要，这一发现可能为理解ALS中轴突变性的早期事件提供新的分子线索。

aiRead.studyType: 体外细胞机制研究（iPSC来源人运动神经元，超分辨成像）
aiRead.keyFinding: 人运动神经元轴突中βII-血影蛋白呈现间隙-斑块模式，该模式由肌动蛋白聚合驱动的血影蛋白局部组装形成，并受星形孢菌素调控。
aiRead.limitation: 研究基于体外iPSC分化模型，未在ALS患者组织或体内模型中验证该模式；星形孢菌素诱导的急性效应与慢性疾病过程的关联尚不明确。
aiRead.watchNext: 后续研究应关注该间隙-斑块模式在ALS相关基因突变（如C9orf72、SOD1）背景下的变化，以及其是否影响轴突的脆弱性和退行进程。

items.abstractZh: 肌动蛋白/血影蛋白膜相关周期性骨架（MPS）是一种支持轴突完整性和功能的细胞骨架结构。下脊髓运动神经元（MNs）的特征是轴突异常长，并且在包括肌萎缩侧索硬化症在内的多种遗传性神经肌肉疾病中特别容易发生变性。利用共聚焦和超分辨成像，我们表征了源自诱导多能干细胞的人运动神经元轴突中βII-血影蛋白的空间分布和MPS的组装模式。我们发现在轴突中部存在一个显著的间隙-斑块模式，其中界限分明的βII-血影蛋白间隙与含有组织良好的MPS的斑块交替出现。该模式由激酶抑制剂星形孢菌素急性诱导，而肌动蛋白聚合的药理学抑制可阻止斑块形成，表明MPS组装需要肌动蛋白成核。我们的数据支持一个模型，即血影蛋白掺入新生的MPS斑块会耗尽邻近区域，从而产生长距离的间隙-斑块模式。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究利用最新超分辨成像技术，在人类iPSC来源的运动神经元中揭示了膜骨架组装的新模式，直接关联ALS等疾病中运动神经元的轴突脆弱性，具有明确的转化价值。

items.title: Upward Effortful Pitch Glide as a Predictor of Pharyngeal Constriction in Individuals With Upper Versus Lower Motor Neuron Lesions.
items.summary: This study tested the validity of using nasoendoscopy ratings of volitional maximum pharyngeal constriction (PCmax) during nasoendoscopy recordings of effortful upward pitch glide to predict pharyngeal area at maximum constriction (PAM) during swallowing recordings (VFSSs) in individuals with upper motor neuron (UMN) versus lower motor neuron (LMN) lesions. Retrospective analysis of electronic medical records identified individuals with UMN or LMN lesions who underwent both VFSS and nasoendoscopy within 3 months. Blinded expert judges rated the degree and symmetry of PCmax in paired nasoendoscopic images of quiet breathing (minimum pharyngeal constriction) and highest pitch production (PCmax). Sixty-five percent of paired images were rated twice for intra- and interrater reliability estimates of agreement; consensus-based ratings were used when disagreement occurred. Comparisons between PCmax ratings and dichotomized VFSS PAM measures from 3-cc and 20-cc liquid bolus trials within UMN and LMN groups were assessed using univariate logistic regression. Forty-six individuals ( N = 24 LMN, 22 UMN) met inclusion criteria. Judge 1 achieved an intraclass correlation coefficient of .76, while Judge 2 achieved .71 intrarater agreement on PCmax measures; interrater agreement was .73 prior to reaching consensus. Nasoendoscopic ratings of PCmax did not differentiate "normal" and "abnormal" VFSS PAM measures in the UMN group ( p = .89). In contrast, the odds ratio for correspondence between high PCmax scores (i.e., greater pharyngeal constriction) and normal PAM measures was 1.91 (95% confidence interval [1.14, 4.52]; p = .053) in the LMN group. Those with LMN lesions show predictable correspondence between PCmax and PAM outcomes, while the PCmax measures of a volitional task may not predict PAM in UMN lesioned individuals.
items.titleZh: 向上费力音调滑动作为上运动神经元与下运动神经元病变患者咽部收缩的预测指标
items.summaryZh: 这项研究评估了通过鼻内镜观察费力向上音调滑动时的咽部收缩程度，是否能预测吞咽时的咽部面积。结果发现，在下运动神经元病变（如某些ALS类型）患者中，这种预测是可行的；但在上运动神经元病变患者中，该指标不能可靠预测吞咽功能。
items.insight: 该研究提示，在评估ALS患者的吞咽功能时，需要根据运动神经元损伤类型（上或下）选择不同的评估方法，因为上运动神经元损伤可能影响自愿任务的执行，导致鼻内镜指标失效。这对ALS临床评估和康复策略有直接参考价值。

aiRead.keyFinding: 下运动神经元病变患者的鼻内镜PCmax评分可预测吞咽时的咽部收缩，但上运动神经元病变患者中该预测不成立。

items.abstractZh: 本研究检验了在鼻内镜检查中，通过费力向上音调滑动期间的自愿最大咽部收缩（PCmax）的鼻内镜评分，来预测上运动神经元（UMN）与下运动神经元（LMN）病变患者在吞咽录像检查（VFSS）中的最大收缩时咽部面积（PAM）的有效性。对电子病历的回顾性分析确定了在3个月内同时接受VFSS和鼻内镜检查的UMN或LMN病变患者。盲法专家评审员对配对鼻内镜图像中安静呼吸（最小咽部收缩）和最高音调产生（PCmax）时的PCmax程度和对称性进行评分。65%的配对图像被评分两次以评估评分者内和评分者间信度；当出现分歧时使用基于共识的评分。通过单变量逻辑回归评估UMN和LMN组内PCmax评分与3毫升和20毫升液体团试验的二分化VFSS PAM测量值之间的比较。46名个体（N=24 LMN，22 UMN）符合纳入标准。评审员1的组内相关系数为0.76，评审员2的评分者内一致性为0.71；达成共识前评分者间一致性为0.73。在UMN组中，PCmax的鼻内镜评分不能区分VFSS PAM测量值的“正常”和“异常”（p=0.89）。相反，在LMN组中，高PCmax评分（即更大的咽部收缩）与正常PAM测量值之间对应的比值比为1.91（95%置信区间[1.14, 4.52]；p=0.053）。LMN病变患者显示PCmax和PAM结果之间存在可预测的对应关系，而UMN病变患者的自愿任务PCmax测量值可能无法预测PAM。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，聚焦于运动神经元病变（包括ALS）中吞咽障碍的评估方法，具有直接的临床转化价值，为区分上、下运动神经元损伤提供了新的功能评估思路。

items.title: Online Crowdfunding Campaigns for People Living With ALS Demonstrate Financial Burden and Unmet Needs.
items.summary: People living with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS; pALS) have extensive care needs, from wheelchairs to feeding tubes to caregiving support. The financial impact of these needs on pALS and their caregivers (cALS) has not been fully explored. We aimed to explore the types of expenses for which pALS and cALS crowdfund, and the financial circumstances that lead them to resort to crowdfunding. We randomly selected 320 ALS-related crowdfunding campaigns posted on the GoFundMe platform from 2010-2020. We conducted a summative content analysis to categorize the expenses for which campaigns requested money and descriptions of financial burden. We included 266 campaigns. Most campaigns were written by people who were not the pALS or cALS, such as children or coworkers (85.3%). Most campaigns fundraised for medication and treatment costs (21.4%), equipment (25.2%), accessibility needs for home (24.0%), and transportation (19.5%), and in-home caregiving services (18%). Multiple campaigns (22.9%) requested assistance with nonmedical expenses ranging from rent and utilities to personal travel and hobby goals. Many campaign writers (47.7%) described financial burden related to the pALS' diagnosis, including medical debt (4.5%) and job loss of the pALS (30.5%) and/or cALS (6.8%). Our analysis of ALS-related crowdfunding campaigns highlights the breadth of medical and nonmedical care needs and quality of life goals for which people request additional financial support throughout the disease course. These findings provide important insights for ALS care teams into the expenses of pALS.

items.titleZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症患者的在线众筹活动揭示经济负担与未满足需求
items.summaryZh: 这项研究分析了2010-2020年间GoFundMe平台上的266个ALS相关众筹活动，发现患者家庭众筹的主要用途包括药物与治疗费用（21.4%）、设备（25.2%）、家庭无障碍改造（24.0%）、交通（19.5%）和居家照护（18%）。近半数活动描述者提到诊断带来的经济负担，包括患者失业（30.5%）和照护者失业（6.8%）。值得注意的是，超过八成活动由非患者本人发起，且22.9%的活动涉及房租、水电等非医疗支出，说明ALS的经济压力远超直接医疗费用。
items.insight: 该研究首次系统性地通过众筹平台数据量化了ALS患者家庭的经济负担全貌，提示临床护理团队在疾病管理中应更早关注患者的社会经济状况，将财务咨询和资源链接纳入多学科照护范畴。

items.abstractZh: 肌萎缩侧索硬化症（ALS；pALS）患者有广泛的护理需求，从轮椅到喂食管再到照护支持。这些需求对pALS及其照护者（cALS）的经济影响尚未被充分探索。我们旨在探讨pALS和cALS众筹的费用类型，以及导致他们诉诸众筹的经济状况。我们随机选取了2010年至2020年间在GoFundMe平台上发布的320个ALS相关众筹活动。我们进行了总结性内容分析，以对活动请求资金的费用类别和经济负担的描述进行分类。我们纳入了266个活动。大多数活动由非pALS或cALS本人撰写，如子女或同事（85.3%）。大多数活动为药物和治疗费用（21.4%）、设备（25.2%）、家庭无障碍改造需求（24.0%）、交通（19.5%）以及居家照护服务（18%）筹款。多个活动（22.9%）请求协助支付非医疗费用，范围从房租和水电费到个人旅行和爱好目标。许多活动撰写者（47.7%）描述了与pALS诊断相关的经济负担，包括医疗债务（4.5%）以及pALS（30.5%）和/或cALS（6.8%）的失业。我们对ALS相关众筹活动的分析凸显了人们在疾病过程中请求额外经济支持的医疗和非医疗护理需求及生活质量目标的广泛性。这些发现为ALS护理团队提供了关于pALS费用的重要见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究基于2026年最新发表的众筹平台数据，直接揭示了ALS患者未被满足的经济支持需求，为临床照护中的社会支持干预提供了转化性依据。

items.title: Clinical and immunological characterization of a child with a homozygous TBK1 kinase-domain truncation.
items.summary: TBK1 is a serine-tyrosine kinase protein that transmits signals from pattern recognition receptors to the NF-κB pathway leading to production of Type 1 Interferons. Mutations in this protein have been associated with arthritis, vasculitis, herpes simplex encephalitis and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. In the current study, we characterized the functional consequences of a TBK1-variant bearing a truncation in exon 4 and 5 in a patient with poly arthritis resembling juvenile idiopathic arthritis and necrotizing encephalitis. The truncation was associated with reduced TBK1 protein abundance and altered phosphorylation. The variant was associated with increased basal/and or Poly-I: C induced IL-6, TNFα, IL-1β and IL-18 and type 1 Interferon ex vivo. Our findings expand the phenotypic spectrum of TBK1 loss-of-function variants and may provide insight into the management of immune dysregulation in affected patients.

items.titleZh: 一例纯合TBK1激酶结构域截短患儿的临床与免疫学特征
items.summaryZh: 本研究报道了一名同时患有多关节炎（类似幼年特发性关节炎）和坏死性脑炎的儿童，其携带TBK1基因纯合截短突变。该突变导致TBK1蛋白表达减少和磷酸化异常，并引起多种炎症因子（IL-6、TNFα、IL-1β、IL-18）和I型干扰素水平升高。研究扩展了TBK1功能缺失相关疾病的临床谱系，提示该基因在免疫调节中的重要作用。
items.insight: TBK1是ALS中公认的致病基因之一，但该研究揭示其纯合截短突变可导致严重的自身炎症和神经炎症表型，提示TBK1功能缺失在神经退行性变和系统性免疫失调之间存在共享的病理机制，对理解ALS中TBK1相关通路具有参考价值。

items.abstractZh: TBK1是一种丝氨酸-酪氨酸激酶蛋白，负责将模式识别受体的信号传递至NF-κB通路，从而诱导I型干扰素的产生。该蛋白的突变与关节炎、血管炎、单纯疱疹病毒性脑炎及肌萎缩侧索硬化（ALS）相关。本研究对一名表现为类似幼年特发性关节炎的多关节炎合并坏死性脑炎患者中，携带TBK1外显子4和5截短变体的功能后果进行了表征。该截短与TBK1蛋白丰度降低及磷酸化改变相关。该变体与离体条件下基础水平和/或Poly-I:C诱导的IL-6、TNFα、IL-1β、IL-18及I型干扰素水平升高相关。我们的发现扩展了TBK1功能缺失变体的表型谱，并可能为受累患者的免疫失调管理提供见解。
items.frontierRationale: 该研究发表于2026年，通过单例纯合突变患者的深度免疫学表征，扩展了TBK1功能缺失的表型谱，为ALS相关基因的免疫病理机制提供了新近的转化视角。
